 This Crl.P. Is Filed U/S 482 Of Cr.P.C., Praying To
Set Aside The Order

DATED 13.09.2024 PASSED BY THE ADDL.DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE (F.T.S.C-1) AT TUMAKURU IN SPL.C.NO.206/2021 FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 506, 376 OF IPC AND UNDER SEC.6 OF POCSO ACT IN ANNEXURE - J BY ALLOWING THIS CRL.P.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA  ORAL ORDER
Though this case is listed for compliance of office objections, with the consent of learned counsel appearing for both the parties, case is taken up for final disposal.

2. Petitioner has filed this petition against the order dated 13.09.2024 passed in Spl.C.No.206/2021 by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge (FTSC-I) at Tumakuru, on the application filed by the accused under Section 91(1) r/w Section 311 of Cr.PC, by which order, the application filed by the petitioner came to be rejected.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge (FTSC-I) at Tumakuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Heard the arguments of both sides and examined the materials placed before this Court.
NC: 2024:KHC:41213 4.
The accused has filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.PC, seeking to recall PWs.1 and 2 to lead further cross-examination and to permit production of photos, for the reasons stated therein.

5. A perusal of the impugned order dated 13.09.2021 reveals that the learned Sessions Judge has rejected the application filed by the accused, while allowing the application filed by the prosecution under Section 311 of Cr.PC to examine Sri Balaraju V., Head Master and Smt. Vijayalakshmi S.,
Police Inspector and also to produce the documents shown in the application filed by the prosecution.
6.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that trial is not yet concluded.
Before conclusion of trial, the application is filed by the accused to recall PW-1 for further cross-examination.
Further he would submit that the accused had taken a specific contention that no toilet is situated in backyard of the house of the accused.
In this regard, confrontation of the photos are very much necessary to prove the case of the accused.

2 7.

sentences.text: Considering the submission of learned counsel for the accused and the facts and circumstances of the present NC: 2024:KHC:41213 case, it is just and proper to provide an opportunity to the accused for further cross-examination of PW-1.
It is a settled principle of law that a fair trial has to be conducted by providing an opportunity to both sides under Article 21 of the Constitution of India.
The order dated 13.09.2024 passed in Spl.C.No.206/2021 by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge (FTSC-I) at Tumakuru is set aside.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge (FTSC-I) at Tumakuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Consequently, the application filed by the accused under Section 91(1) r/w Section 311 of Cr.PC is allowed.
iii. The trial Court is directed to provide an opportunity to the accused for further cross- examination of PW-1 as sought for.
Thereafter, trial Court is directed to proceed with the matter in accordance with law.

Sd/-
(G BASAVARAJA) JUDGE PN Saifulla @ Sail Ali Khan vs State Of Karnataka on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166914544/
